scripts.deploy:website: bun --env-file=.env x wrangler pages deploy --cwd website --branch main

CYRIS_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: **Required.** Your Cloudflare Access team domain as a host without a scheme, e.g. `yourteam.cloudflareaccess.com`. The Worker fetches the team's signing keys from it and checks each sign-in's issuer against it.

CYRIS_ACCESS_AUD.description: **Required.** The Application Audience (AUD) tag of the self-hosted Access application that guards this Worker, shown on the application's overview page in Zero Trust.

DIGEST_ORIGIN.description: Optional. The Pages origin this Worker proxies the public archive from, e.g. `https://your-project.pages.dev`. Set it only when the archive lives somewhere other than `<CYRIS_PROMOTE_PAGES_PROJECT>.pages.dev` — a custom domain, say. Unset with no project named either, `/` answers 503.

CYRIS_STORE_DATABASE_ID.description: **Required.** The D1 database UUID from `wrangler d1 create cyris` or the dashboard. The container reaches D1 over REST rather than through a binding, so this is an id you paste, not a binding the deploy provisions.

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.description: **Required.** Your account id, shown in the dashboard URL and on any Workers page.

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: **Required.** An [API token](https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens) with `D1:Edit` and `Cloudflare Pages:Edit`. This is what publishes the digest and reads the store. Add `Workers Scripts:Read` so the digest link can find this Worker's custom domain.

CYRIS_PROMOTE_PAGES_PROJECT.description: **Required.** The Pages project name the digest deploys to. The Worker serves the archive from `<name>.pages.dev` unless `DIGEST_ORIGIN` overrides it.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional: one LLM key for the provider you choose, or none if you choose `None — plain excerpts`. **After the deploy finishes, open `/settings` and choose the provider** — it lives in D1, not in this form, and until one is saved every run stops. [Anthropic Claude](https://console.anthropic.com/).

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Alternative to `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`; pick `gemini` on `/settings` to use it — [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey).

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Alternative to `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`; pick `openai` on `/settings` to use it — [OpenAI](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys).

CYRIS_PRIVATE_ARCHIVE.description: Optional. Set to `true` to put the archive behind the same Cloudflare Access sign-in as `/settings`; a reader without one gets a 403. Leave blank for a public archive.

CYRIS_WORKER_TOKEN.description: Optional. The one bearer the rss and newsletter Workers accept. Set it here and in those Workers; leave blank to poll feeds directly at digest time.

CYRIS_RSS_WORKER_URL.description: Optional. The `workers/rss/` buffer, e.g. `https://cyris-rss.<sub>.workers.dev`. Blank falls back to polling every feed at digest time, which loses articles a busy feed has already rotated out.

CYRIS_NEWSLETTER_WORKER_URL.description: Optional. The `workers/newsletter/` email ingester. Needs a domain on Cloudflare Email Routing — the one setup step that cannot be automated.

CYRIS_PROMOTE_WORKER_URL.description: Optional. The `workers/promote/` vote Worker, e.g. `https://cyris-promote.<sub>.workers.dev`. Blank means a 👍/👎 click is refused (503) instead of recorded.

CYRIS_PROMOTE_TOKEN.description: Optional. The `workers/promote/` bearer, the same value as that Worker's `PROMOTE_TOKEN`. It stays server-side: readers vote through this Worker's `POST /api/vote`, which attaches it. Keep it distinct from `CYRIS_WORKER_TOKEN`.

CYRIS_PROMOTE_CUSTOM_DOMAIN.description: Optional. Overrides the digest link's host. Unset, a run uses the custom domain attached to this Worker. On a domainless deploy set it to this Worker's `*.workers.dev` hostname.

CLOUDFLARE_EMBEDDING_API_TOKEN.description: Optional. A `Workers AI:Read` token for `@cf/baai/bge-m3` vote-similarity filtering. Not the same token as `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`.

CLOUDFLARE_AI_TOKEN.description: Optional. A `Workers AI:Read` token for the `workers_ai` LLM provider and the Clef vote order. Blank falls back to `CLOUDFLARE_EMBEDDING_API_TOKEN`, which the same permission already covers.

CLOUDFLARE_AIG_TOKEN.description: Optional. An `Account > AI Gateway > Run` token for the `ai_gateway` LLM provider, sent as `cf-aig-authorization`. It has no fallback: the Workers AI tokens are refused by the gateway.
